  "intuition": "Transform the traditional pairwise margin loss into a contrastive loss using a sigmoid-weighted relative advantage to prioritize harder distinctions, encouraging the model to emphasize more nuanced preference differences.",

  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))\n    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']\n    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']\n    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']\n    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 5.0))\n    eps = 1e-8\n    denom = ops.add(ops.abs(adv_w), ops.abs(adv_l))\n    denom = ops.add(denom, eps)\n    rel_adv = ops.div(adv_gap, denom)\n    weighting = ops.sigmoid(ops.mul(scale, rel_adv))\n    margin = ops.mul(rel_adv, ops.sub(lpw, lpl))\n    loss = ops.neg(ops.mul(ops.mul(weight, weighting), ops.logsigmoid(margin)))\n    return ops.mean(loss)"
}

  "intuition": "The original loss used logsigmoid on (advantage_w - advantage_l), but advantages can have large magnitude causing numerical instability with logsigmoid. Additionally, we simplify by directly using advantage signals difference weighted by nonnegative weights, preserving semantics while improving stability.",
